The user wants to ensure that if the LSP process crashes or stops responding, the application automatically detects it and restarts it without user intervention.

T1 found the detection mechanism: `async worker main` checks `job lsp transport running` (which implies `is running` is false, typically due to poll failure or fd closure in the reader thread), setting `pending transport restart true`.
T1 also found the restart orchestration: `restart lsp for workspace` is triggered after detection via `ensure async worker running` -> `start async worker` -> `async worker main` -> detection -> flag -> application loop calls `
